dedupe_keys.name: be h2 hypatia milp hydrogen network infrastructure cost optimisation model for belgium ku leuven energyville vito

description: BE-H2-Hypatia is the dataset and case model for a long-term hydrogen infrastructure cost optimisation of Belgium, focused on decarbonising energy-intensive industries, released on Zenodo by Negar Namazifard of KU Leuven, EnergyVille and VITO. The README describes a mixed-integer linear programme with high spatial and hourly resolution that optimises investment in and operation of hydrogen production, the transmission network and storage. It chooses among pipe sizes such as DN500, DN900 and DN1200 between node pairs from hourly flows, with size-dependent fixed and variable costs taken from European Hydrogen Backbone values. Scenarios cover green and blue production and imports of clean molecules and report system levelised cost of hydrogen and capacity adequacy. It is run with the development branch of the Hypatia framework in a Python 3.8 environment. Release v0.1.5 is free on Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 and dates from February 2024. Coverage is Belgium. Caveats: it depends on a development branch, and the repository licence and activity could not be read because the GitHub API was rate-limited. Simulation uses are hydrogen pipeline network sizing and capacity adequacy for national planning. Related records: model-lanl-phydras-hydrogen-blending-pipelines and model-pitea-hydrogen-pipeline-techno-economic are other hydrogen pipeline models.
